_doc: Way of Vanilla content phases. week = weeks after launch (logs/fresh-start-at). 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD) overrides the week: wov/phases.py move N DATE. Brackets are mod-progression-system brackets switched on at that phase. lock_* = quests/maps kept shut (disables, comment 'wov-phase') until the phase is live.

phases.name: The Ahn'Qiraj War Effort
phases.note: 60_3_2 opens the war effort quests and the Scarab Lord chain. The gates (AQ20/AQ40 maps, AQ class quests) stay shut until the war effort is done: wov/phases.py open-gates (sets aq_gates_open and switches on 60_3_3).

phases.name: Naxxramas
phases.note: Map 533 is the WotLK level 80 Naxxramas: it stays shut until a Naxx 40 is in place. Scourge Invasion starts with this phase.
